build_autoscheme_mixed_precision: build an AutoScheme with target avg_bits and quantization options like GGUF or MXFP4
build_autoround_quantizer: build an AutoRound quantizer with a model path and AutoScheme for mixed precision quantization
test_autoround_quantize: test AutoRound quantize method to quantize a model and return layer config
test_autoround_quantize_and_save: test AutoRound quantize_and_save to quantize a model and export it in GGUF format
test_compute_avg_bits_for_model: test compute_avg_bits_for_model to verify the average bits per weight of a quantized model
